item.title: Using Rustdesk with Tailscale
item.description: I have a Steam Deck and a Lenovo Ideapad running SteamOS and Debian. I mostly use Debian for devlopement. So I’d like to remote desktop into my Laptop from the steam deck. I’ll be using RustDesk and Tailscale. This post will focus on configuring RustDesk and setting up the relay server on the laptop. Requirements Tailscale should be configured on both machines. Docker should be installed for the relay server Setting up client Machines Make sure to get the version depending on your distro from the releases page.

item.title: Learning to program through emulation
item.description: So I grew up with the Nintendo Wii and DS. The days of playing Wii Sports, Mario Kart and Super Mario Bros DS will forever hold a special place in my childhood. The joy of getting a bullet bill during the last lap and the thrill of getting a KO in boxing are some of my most memorable moments in gaming. Fastforward a couple of years, with the Wii slowing dropping support with the closing of the Wii shop and introduction of the Wii U, there wasn’t really anything to fill my void of Nintendo games (and my parents weren’t willing to buy me another console either).
